name: The Black Flame
description: Seraphina's vision showed a black flame burning in the old watchtower on the Merchant's Highway, and kneeling men feeding it. Put it out.

start_condition.start_hint: Talk to Seraphina in the Temple of the Dawnflame once you've seen her vision.

stages.description: The vision showed the flame below the watchtower. Find the way down to its cellar.

objectives.description: Find the entrance to the tower basement.

stages.description: The cellar is full of kneeling men in black. Stop them, and find out what they were promised.
A Shadow Stalker is anchoring the darkness here. Destroy it.
The immediate threat is neutralized. Return to the Oracle with your findings.

objectives.description: Deliver the Shadow Fragment and cult plans.

offer.option: I am ready to start with the tower.

offer.text: Then listen. The flame is below the tower, not in it. In the vision I was looking up at the stairs. There is a cellar the bandits found, or made. Whatever is down there, it is anchored to that flame. Put it out, and bring me anything they wrote down. People who kneel always write things down.

anchored.label: Anchored?
anchored.text: Something that is not supposed to be here is being held here. I felt it watching me through the bowl. It knew it was being looked at. I don't think it liked it.

accept.label: I'll put out the flame.
accept.text: Go carefully. Take light with you. Whatever waits there hates the light, I'm sure of that much.

decline.label: Not yet.
decline.text: Rest, then. It will still be burning.

cellar.label: I haven't found the cellar yet.
cellar.text: Look low. The old towers had root cellars for the garrison's stores, and the way down is usually by the hearth.

cultists.label: The cellar is full of cultists.
cultists.text: Then they are still feeding it. Stop them, and look for their writings. Someone gave them orders.

stalker.label: Something else is down there. It's made of shadow.
stalker.text: That is what it was anchoring. You'll want light, and steady nerves. When it dies it will leave something behind: bring it to me.

after.text: Enough to frighten me. The flame was one of several. They speak of an Eye, under the water in Shadowmere, that the flames were feeding. The fragment you brought is cold as a grave and it points toward the swamp. The amulet is yours. Wear it where the dark is thickest.
